description: Proposed authorization policy. UI visibility is not authorization; enforce every permission on trusted backend/security rules.
invariants: Users cannot grant or elevate their own roles.
Role assignments are written only by trusted privileged code.
Authors cannot publish, approve, or alter reviewer decisions.
Reviewers can decide only content assigned to them.
Students can read and mutate only their own private records.
Quiz score and leaderboard values must be calculated or validated server-side.
Public reads expose published content only and must not reveal private user fields.
All privileged mutations create an append-only audit event.
migration_note: Do not deploy this policy to the existing Firestore project until existing data, admin accounts, required queries, and emulator tests have been reviewed.
